issues.message: The source text specifies 'Free Promotional Housing' (ترقوي حر), but the translation maps this to the acronym 'LPL' (Logement Public Locatif), which is social housing. This is a severe factual and programmatic error.
Incorrectly maps 'Free Promotional Housing' to 'LPL' (Logement Public Locatif). This is a major terminology contradiction.
